topSignals.title: Seventh consecutive quiet day — Elcogen now 19 days quiet, Topsoe 86 days.
topSignals.text: Dedicated searches for both priority stacks, this cycle's Tier 2 rotation (SolydEra, Mitsubishi Power) and sweep, the Tier 3 rotation cycle 11 round 3 (Plansee, Huatsing Power, Ningbo SOFCMAN, Chaozhou Three-Circle/CCTC, Delta Electronics, Shell) and two further Tier 3 sweeps, and broad AI-datacenter/hyperscaler (English and German), regulation, competing-power, market/financials, research/IP and scientific-paper checks all returned only recycled/already-logged background or unverifiable items (see notes below). Nothing confirmed beat or neared any row in SOFC_Benchmark_Records.md. For Dominic: a secondhand claim of a DynElectro 25,000-hour SOEC stack test at 0.05%/1000h degradation surfaced today but could not be traced to any primary source — every hit was a bare LinkedIn profile-page artifact repeating the headline with no linkable article, press release, or date — so it is flagged for a manual check next time (if genuine, it would beat both registered degradation rows by 4-10x) but NOT adopted as a new benchmark. No action needed on the LCOE model otherwise; SPP's FERC large-load show-cause answer (due Nov 20) still has not produced analyzable trade-press coverage.

items.text: Elcogen (priority): 19 days quiet (since the Nov 2 Hygreen Energy MoU). No new item found today; a resurfaced Elcogen "massmanufacturable fuel cell platform" story was confirmed to be the already-registered May 2026 elcoStack E3000 G2 launch, not new.

Topsoe (priority): 86 days quiet on SOFC/SOEC specifically (since the Aug 27 H1 2026 results/SOEC pathway reset). No new item found today; Topsoe's press feed remains active but non-solid-oxide (SOEC-for-PtX, ammonia, e-SAF with Carbon Neutral Fuels).

Today's Tier 2 dedicated rotation (SolydEra, Mitsubishi Power): no new item for either; SolydEra's top headline remains its Hannover Messe 2026 PMX-platform launch (already logged) and Mitsubishi Power's remains its Takasago SOEC test-module background (non-SOFC, already logged).

Tier 2 sweep ("Bloom Energy OR FuelCell Energy OR Ceres Power OR Sunfire OR SolydEra"): no new item; recycled Bloom's 2024-vintage 60% efficiency milestone and standing Amazon-headquarters background. The unverifiable DynElectro degradation claim (see Top Signals) surfaced adjacent to a SolydEra/Dynelectro 1 MW electrolyser partnership story during this check, itself already-logged 2024 background.

Tier 3 rotation — cycle 11, round 3 (Plansee, Huatsing Power, Ningbo SOFCMAN, Chaozhou Three-Circle/CCTC, Delta Electronics, Shell), plus two cross-company sweeps: no new item for any; recycled Delta's standing Ceres-license/Centrica-partnership background, Shell's already-logged July 2026 10 MW Ceres SOEC module contract, and Chaozhou Three-Circle's only fresh item being an unrelated capital-structure/ESOP EGM notice (corporate governance, not a technology or KPI update).
Competitor roster: SOFC systems for data centers

Bloom Energy: Deployed/signed at multiple named sites — Oracle/Project Jupiter, AEP/Google Cheyenne Fuel Cell LLC (702 MW/$4B, 20-yr PPA), Brookfield EaaS, Nebius (328 MW/$2.6B), Equinix (>100 MW/19 sites), Aligned "Project Phoenix" (2 GW), Hitachi (Japan), SK Eternix (28 MW, operational), NTT DATA (900 MW, global, shipments from 2027).

FuelCell Energy (incl. HyAxiom-branded products): Signed orders/PPAs — Fit Energy (up to 380 MW), Inuverse Korea (up to 100 MW), Texas CRA (75 MW), SDCL (up to 450 MW). Also hosting the DOE/national-lab-backed StabilityMax R&D testbed in Danbury, CT. No named commercial deployment live yet.
Doosan Fuel Cell/HyAxiom: Signed order — US AI data center supply contract (KRW 823.6B); supplies SOFC stacks to Reverion. No named data-center site of its own yet.
Convion: Pipeline-only/pre-commercial under HD Hyundai ownership; no named data-center customer.
SK ecoplant: Pipeline-only; no named data-center deployment.
Ceres Power's SOFC licensees (Doosan, Delta Electronics, Weichai): Licensing/pipeline-only; no named data-center deployment via Ceres licensing directly.
Reverion: Pipeline-only — Doosan-supplied SOFC stacks for rSOC power plants (Germany); no named data-center customer yet.
Petra Power: Pre-commercial, no named customer; first infrastructure deployment targeted 2028.
EGEN Energy (China, watch-list): Pre-commercial/early-stage; no named data-center customer yet.
